title: SETTINGS HAS A DETAIL PANE
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): make the menus look like a AAA game, checked in pictures. The right third of the Settings window was empty beside the list. It is now a detail pane, as in the settings of big shooters: the setting under the mouse or the pad, its name large, its value and its whole description in a readable size.
now: Settings shows the pointed setting large in a detail pane beside the list.
